LanguageData.DS_SetBills: Count network items in "do until X" bills
LanguageData.DS_SetBillsTip: Bills that make a product will see items stored in online cores and stop when enough exist.
LanguageData.DS_SetPerishTip: Stored items do not tick, so food stored in a core does not rot. Turn this off to refuse perishable items.
LanguageData.DS_SetSpill: Max stacks dropped when a core is destroyed (the rest is lost): {0}
LanguageData.DS_NoCore: No powered storage core in range.
LanguageData.DS_InsertDriveDesc: Choose a data drive on the map. A colonist carries it to the core and slots it in.
LanguageData.DS_EjectDriveDesc: Remove a drive. Only possible if the remaining drives can still hold everything stored.
LanguageData.DS_NoDriveOnMap: No usable data drive on the map.
LanguageData.DS_NoPawn: No colonist can reach both the drive and the core.
LanguageData.DS_CannotEject: Cannot eject: the remaining drives could not hold the stored items or item types.
